name: Eve Energy (Matter, EU)

radios.note: Eve lists Thread. The CSA listing for 20EBO8301 also shows Bluetooth as a transport, likely for setup, but Eve doesn't confirm it.

matter.note: CSA lists variant SKU 20EBO8301 under Eve Energy certificates (e.g. CSA22065MAT40065-24, firmware 3.1.0). Eve's identify page gives product no. 10EBO8351 for the Matter EU model.

apple_home.note: Through Matter, normally with an Apple home hub that is a Thread border router. With iOS 18 and an iPhone 15 Pro or later, Eve says it can be controlled locally without a hub, minus remote access and automations.

google_home.note: Through Matter. Needs a Google hub that is a Matter controller and Thread border router.

alexa.note: Through Matter. Needs an Echo that is a Matter controller and Thread border router.

smartthings.note: Through Matter. Needs a SmartThings hub with Thread.

home_assistant.note: Through the Home Assistant Matter integration. Needs a Thread border router on the network.

hubRequired.note: Eve's EU product page says it needs a Matter + Thread hub, but Eve's iOS 18 post lists Europe 4th gen for hub-free local control from an iPhone 15 Pro+. Every non-Apple platform needs a hub, so treat it as needed.

localControl.note: Matter over Thread runs on the local network. Eve says it needs no Eve account and has no Eve cloud.

energyMonitoring.note: Built-in power meter. Eve's April 2025 firmware moved it to standard Matter energy reporting (power, voltage, current, total use), installable via Apple Home, Google Home, Home Assistant or SmartThings.

maxLoadWatts.note: Eve's technical specs give max. 11 A / 2500 W for the European model; the relay cuts out above 11 A. The 16 A / 3680 W figure belongs to Eve Energy Outdoor.

summary: All five big platforms (Apple Home, Google Home, Alexa, SmartThings and Home Assistant) can control the EU Eve Energy, and every one of them does it through Matter over Thread. Plan on a Thread border router: an Apple home hub, a Google or SmartThings hub with Thread, or an Echo that is also a Matter controller. On iOS 18, an iPhone 15 Pro or later can switch it locally with no hub, minus remote access and automations. Model 20EBO8301 (product no. 10EBO8351) has a built-in power meter, is rated 11 A / 2500 W, and needs no Eve account or cloud.
caveats: Google Home, Alexa, SmartThings and Home Assistant all need a Thread border router; for Alexa, the Echo must be both a Matter controller and a border router.
Hub-free control from an iPhone 15 Pro or later on iOS 18 is local only; remote access and automations still need an Apple home hub.
Rated 11 A / 2500 W, and the relay cuts out above 11 A; Eve's 16 A / 3680 W figure belongs to Eve Energy Outdoor.
Standard Matter energy readings (power, voltage, current, total use) need Eve's April 2025 firmware or later.
